egress.terms: 'Traffic included' with a 'Traffic flat rate'; the page sells additional traffic at EUR 0.012 per GB for plans that allow an upgrade
egress.free_allowance: flat rate, not quantified on the plan card

interface_detail: root SSH, snapshots and a remote console
tooling: any SSH client; netcup SCP panel
chaining: a European 4 GiB box with a traffic flat rate, but the entry price is now nearly double ceiling

limits.value: 12-month minimum contract; the page's product links carry 12m and 24m variants

binding_note: the binding constraint is the 12-month contract at EUR 8.26 a month, not any technical quota; the price alone puts it out.

identity_cost.detail: an account and a payment method at order

reliability_note: no reliability event observed; the vendor states a 99.9% minimum availability on an annual average for root servers and excludes it for VPS

notes: The vendor's lineup today is G12.5: VPS 500 G12.5 at EUR 8.26, VPS 1000 G12.5 at EUR 14.50, and no G11 plan is listed on the page. EUR 8.26 is USD 9.25 at the ECB rate, so the entry rung is nearly twice ceiling and netcup is out entirely rather than a near miss. The 6-month and 24-month rates are not published on this page; the product links carry both 12m and 24m variants, so a 24-month rate exists and is lower, but its number was not read.

extras.price_arithmetic: EUR 8.26/month excl. VAT x 1.1193 = USD 9.25/month; EUR 99.12 a year out of pocket
extras.renewal_note: contract renews at the then-current rate; no promo price is shown on this page
